name: Al Hameed
description: Allah is worthy of all praise for His perfect attributes and acts.
summary: The name Al Hameed emphasizes the significance of Allah's nature as deserving of all praise and commendation. It recognizes that all good qualities and actions originate from Him, and humanity is encouraged to acknowledge and express gratitude for His blessings. The term comes from the Arabic root 'ḥ-m-d,' which relates to praise and commendation.
